infeasibility_proof: Toy: two targets on the same side of 0.5, each at least tol from 0.5. Fixed points obey w r + I = theta + k logit(r), so two fixed points r1 < r2 force w = k L with L the secant slope of logit; stability w F'(u) < 1 with F' = r (1 - r) / k reads L r (1 - r) < 1 (independent of all parameters). logit is concave below 0.5 and convex above, so for two states on the same side the secant slope exceeds logit' at the inner (below 0.5: the upper) state and the condition fails at one of them. See bench/infeasible.py.
